body.x: 'Well,' by definition, means a peaceful state without any disturbance. When I think about the meaning, I would like to say that modern people don’t have many days that goes ‘well.’ Science develops and effective drugs are poured out, but the population exposed to the disease is increasing day by day and it is hard to find people without "disease".

Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs says the most fundamental, the first and second stage desires are 'physiological desire' and 'desire for safety'. No matter how magnificent and dreamy people are, the desire for health and safety lies in the heart more than anything else. This is why the healthcare industry is constantly gaining popularity around the world.
(Video description: CES 2018 video _ Health and medical technologyfuture, 'Digital Health Zone')

What is fun is that now IT and Health have met and a new industrial field called 'Digital Health' has been created and business has been extended to it. In April, the Center for Biotechnology Policy Research predicted that the global health care IT market will grow by 6.4 percent year-on-year to $ 114.8 billion (about 122 trillion won) in the '2018 Global Healthcare Industry Forecast' report.

The digital health industry has a noticeable impact on the global market. In line with the market conditions, CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas from January 8 to November 11, 2019, will select the "digital health" industry as a theme.
(Picture: Omron's blood pressure smart watch introduced at CES 2018)

According to the CES website, the digital health industry says that consumers can enjoy services through technology. Already ranging from remote monitoring products to wearables and diagnostic solutions, various healthcare solutions offer patients a convenient and smart experience. The digital health industry is a new technology that forms the lifestyle of modern people today.

CES 2019 will provide a more concrete and empirical overview of the future healthcare industry. If you are interested in the "digital health industry" that represents the medical revolution, or if you are involved in the related industry, it would be good to summarize the directions to analyze and actively participate in the CES.
(Photo caption: 'Colgate' smart toothbrush introduced at CES 2018)

In addition to smart health care, CES 2019, a global stage andgroundbreaking technology demonstration, will cover a wide range of topics.Topics include: ▲ 5G ▲ IOT ▲ Block Chain ▲ Wireless Service ▲ Health & Wearables▲ Smart Home ▲ Sports ▲ Product Packaging ▲ 3D Printing ▲ ArtificialIntelligence ▲ Advertising, Entertainment & Contents ▲ 3D Printing ▲Artificial Intelligence ▲ Robot ▲ Tourism ▲ Drone ▲ Life ▲ Smart City ▲Automobile, etc.

On the other hand, AVING NEWS, the media company that is most passionate about advertising Korean companies in the world, is planning to launch the CES 2019 start-up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT as a project to help domestic start-ups to advance into the global market. Considering the advantages of CES, which is not a traditional joint venture, it plans to expose promising start-ups to investors, businesses and media through a variety of programs including participation strategy consulting, public relations marketing, and networking parties. Particularly, on the third evening of the exhibition, the company plans to hold a 'MIK NIGHT' party, a business networking party, inviting investors and media that companies have met. MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT is jointly planned and operated by AVING NEWS and Global MICE Expert Group, GMEG.
